name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
benefit: Credit-linked margin-money subsidy for eligible new micro-enterprises
eligibility: New micro-enterprises; project, applicant, and location criteria apply

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE)
benefit: Credit guarantee support for eligible lending to micro and small enterprises
eligibility: Micro and small enterprises borrowing through participating lenders

name: Udyam Registration
benefit: Official MSME registration and access point for scheme eligibility
eligibility: Enterprises meeting current MSME classification criteria
